card.name: Last word of a section heading
card.fires_on: The final word of a section or subsection heading in drug labels, just before the body text begins. Often follows a number like 5.3 or 2.1 and ends a title such as 'Corneal Endothelial Cell Injury'.

modes.label: Numbered label headings
modes.description: Last word of a numbered subsection title in a label.
modes.example: 5.3 Corneal Endothelial Cell<< Injury>> Gatifloxacin ophthalmic solution

modes.label: Unnumbered condition headings
modes.description: End of a disease name used as a heading inside a warning paragraph.
modes.example: PA, with effects similar to those of overdosage (see OVERDOSAGE ), unless dosage is adjusted for the individual patient. Myasthen<<ia>> Gravis Patients with myasthenia

modes.label: Web page titles
modes.description: End of a title in scraped web text, before a break.
modes.example: Easy Magic Tricks for Scouts > > > Triple Pr<<izes>> < < < piece of paper -

card.writes: It promotes long runs of blank lines and suppresses single line breaks, so it adds a big paragraph break after a heading.
card.plain: It spots the last word of a heading, where a gap and then the body text should follow.
